problem: The first A7 harness called the independent high-accuracy surface reference from candidate_flux_state, and candidate_flux_state was also used inside every candidate nonlinear residual evaluation. The reference value did not affect the residual or candidate flux, but contaminated qualification wall-clock cost and caused unnecessary expensive oracle calls.
repair: Use the identical candidate surface/internal flux algebra inside the nonlinear residual without any high-accuracy diagnostic oracle. After the nonlinear candidate trial has converged, call the high-accuracy surface reference once at the accepted candidate state to compute the frozen surface-q qualification metric.

scientific_identity_unchanged.surface_candidate_cost_caps: 530 constitutive K evaluations and 66 root residual evaluations

why_numerical_solution_is_unchanged: The removed high-accuracy call was diagnostic-only. Its return values were never used in the candidate residual, candidate qtop, internal fluxes, Jacobian approximation or nonlinear acceptance state. Moving it after convergence changes instrumentation timing only.
decision_rule: The repaired runner must satisfy the original frozen A7 precommit. No threshold or fixture may change.
hard_guards: Do not use this repair to alter any scientific acceptance threshold.
Do not suppress a candidate/reference mismatch or solver failure.
Do not count qualification-only oracle time as production RossFast candidate cost.
Preserve the original A7 run and its eventual conclusion as provenance.

architecture_checks.15_coupling_cost: No hidden reference calculation is placed in the normal candidate residual path.
architecture_checks.23_policy_separation: Reference diagnostics are separated from candidate numerical physics.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: Candidate residual cost is again bounded by candidate face operations rather than qualification oracle latency.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: High-accuracy reference remains available outside the candidate path.
